title: Playing with Louis Armstrong and Joe Oliver
summary: Armstrong sat in at the Dreamland; Palmer worked more with Oliver around 1922, alternating Dreamland and Royal Garden.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Oh yeah, clarinetist, that's right. Played with Oliver. Mm-hmm. Did you ever play with Louis Armstrong? Louis Armstrong, I played with him a while a little bit. He played with us over at the Dream. We had him playing with us there. He played with us a while over there. But I never played regular with Louis. I played more regular with Joe Oliver than I did Louis.

I was with Oliver about 1922 I think or 20, something like that. Royal Garden? Yeah, we was over there. We used to alternate. We used to shift from the Dreamland to, uh, Dreamland to, uh, Royal Garden. And after Louis, after Joe got here a while, he got with a band. He wasn't with a band when he come here. And he had to send and get the boys with him, see. And then Louis Armstrong was in St. Louis, see. Louis come from St. Louis here. Yeah, he'd been on the boat. Yeah. So, that was our, that was our starts and our beginnings. 된 stuff
